title: Lowo Owakhothama Phambi Kwakhe Izibonakaliso Zakhe Umbuso
intro: Uhambo olumangalisayo lulindele labo abanesibindi sokuxazulula le mfihlakalo. Emakhasini angaphakathi esAmbulo, kwakukhona umbusi okuhlangana kwakhe nomprofethi kwakuzokwakha kabusha isizwe sonke. Lo muntu wabusa esihlalweni sobukhosi esikude, eqondiswa amasiko asendulo, kwaze kwaba yilapho iqiniso laphezulu lishintsha kokubili umbusi nombuso kuze kube phakade. Ingabe uzokwembula ukuthi ungubani lo mphefumulo omangalisayo onendaba ehlanganisa okungavamile nokujulile?
clues: Ngangibusa isizwe esichumayo ngaphesheya kwamanzi akude, esaziwa ngezingadi zethu nesigodlo sethu eside.
Igunya lami laliphakeme kakhulu, kodwa umbuso omkhulu weza ukuzophonsela inselelo ukuba khona kwethu kanye nobuntu bethu.
Inyoni encane yayiphethe umyalezo ongavamile, futhi izimangaliso ezalandela zachitha yonke imibono yami ngamandla.
Lapho ngibona isihlalo sobukhosi siguqulwa phambi kwamehlo ami, ngangazi ukuthi akekho umuntu ongaba namakhono anjalo.
Ngamemezela obala ukuzithoba kwami ​​eNkosini eyodwa yamazulu nomhlaba, ngashiya konke engangikuthanda kakhulu.
Thina, njengesizwe, safulathela ukukhulekelwa kwelanga kwasendulo futhi samukela iqiniso elashintsha konke.

outcome.answer: Sazithoba ku-Allah futhi samukela ukholo lweqiniso

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
